div.p: Internal projected-cost visibility from local coding-harness usage. Not billing. Not work-content monitoring. Local ccusage data only.

ul.li: No Maven, Gradle, Spring, servlet container, npm install, bundler, or DB server.
mise is the public entry; java -ea tools/Build.java ... is the build authority.
Runtime uses JPMS, jdk.httpserver, virtual threads, JStachio, Datastar.
State is append-only event log plus replayed in-memory projection.
Assertions are mandatory in dev, test, and prod.

text.tspan: Java 26+ service · auth · UI · event log
